text: Did you know how many pull ups you should be able to do based on your age? Let's find out. If you're around 10 years old, even one to two clean pull ups is a solid achievement. At 15, aim for around three to five. You're building the upper body strength that will help you for years to come. At 20, hitting five to 10 clean pull ups is a strong target. Your back, arms, and grip should all be working together to lift your entire body. In your 30s, four [music] to eight clean pull ups is a solid goal to work toward because maintaining strength becomes just as important as building [music] it. At 50, even one to four clean pull ups is a worthwhile target. And if you're over 60 and can still perform [music] one or two strict pull ups, that's a great achievement. Remember, no swinging, no kicking, just controlled reps with a full range of motion. Now, be honest. How old [music] are you? And how many pull ups can you do right now?
